description.value: The Jammery is a landmark breakfast and lunch restaurant on Highway 97 North that has operated for over 25 years and earned a feature on the Food Network's 'You Gotta Eat Here!' It occupies seven acres of agricultural land combining a full-service restaurant, gift shop, and an on-site jam production facility visible through a viewing window. The menu spotlights award-winning homemade jams made from local B.C. fruit alongside all-day breakfast classics, making it a well-known stop on this busy cycling corridor between Kelowna and Vernon.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms The Jammery is an active, well-established restaurant at 8038 Hwy 97 North, with the street address and phone number (250) 766-1139 corroborating the OSM record; the copyright footer reads 2026, indicating a current site. Takeout is explicitly advertised on the homepage, and the menu page contains an explicit vegetarian substitution note. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging information appears anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM lists the city as 'Kelowna' but the website labels the 8038 Hwy 97N location as 'Lake Country'; the street address and postcode match so the record is likely correct, but the municipality attribution may be imprecise.
OSM cuisine tag is 'sandwich' but the restaurant is a full-service breakfast and lunch venue; the tag is misleading.
OSM contains no phone number; phone (250) 766-1139 sourced from website only, so cross-check against OSM was not possible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a confirmed website, established 25-year presence, and location directly on Highway 97 — a primary cycling route through the Kelowna/Lake Country corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page explicitly notes 'MAKE IT VEGETARIAN WITH SUNDRIED TOMATO AND MUSHROOMS!' as a substitution on the Chorizo Toss; no vegan or gluten-free options explicitly mentioned
